resources.string:
Your games go on the EASYROMS drive of this SD card. If you add them now, Daijishou finds them the first time it opens:

1. Choose Shut down now.
2. Put the SD card in a computer. Copy each game into the folder of its system on EASYROMS, like nes, snes, gba or psx.
3. If you have BIOS files (PlayStation, Sega CD and a few other systems need them), copy them into the bios folder on EASYROMS.
4. If you have Android apps (.apk files), copy them into a folder named apk on EASYROMS. The console offers to install them when it starts.
5. Put the card back and start the console. Daijishou opens and asks to look for games: press OK.

Or go on now and add games later.
